provisional_rows.start_line: When Matthew and Maria Raine sued OpenAI in August 2025 over the death of their 16-year-old son
provisional_rows.milestone: Whether artificial intelligence should be built and deployed as fast as possible to capture its benefits, or slowed and controlled until its risks are better understood.
provisional_rows.stakes: The argument turns on whether machines that mimic human judgment can be trusted with decisions that affect jobs, safety, and truth itself.
